Sorry for the delay I was sick over the weekend. Here's the patch notes for update 6/9
- New skin colors: Red, Green, Blue, and Purple
- New pet :eyes:

- Fixed the RainPak breaking at levels above 82

notes.title: The Big Pet Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone sorry for the long wait but we're finally releasing the big pet update! I'm really excited about the changes this update brings as I think it really focuses the game on what everyone has found the most fun; pets! Here's a list of what's new and what's changed.

New

 Pet Station - Befriending your creatures will now make them residents of your planet instead of just being put away in storage. Residents will roam your planet and interact with one another. The Pet Station is where you can manage what pets you want to keep around. The storage is still there to keep any pets that overflow the station. Upgrades to the station size will be coming in a future update.
 Feeding - Feed your pets to increase the new PetPak level. There are no longer star levels for each PetPak but a level 1-100 for each slot on your pet. Without revealing too much, I can say that PetPaks now work on a whole new system. This means recipes have changed for PetPaks and so you will have to discover them all over again. Each pet whether befriended or hatched will have different comptabilities with different PetPaks. Feeding items and PetPaks will now show up in the indicator when you get close to pets.
 Eggs! - Get your pets to romance and lay an egg! Hatch the egg to get a pet that inherits traits from its parents. Certain pet colors can only be obtained through romancing!
 Pet Naming - You can now name your pets! Pet names can be a maximum of 12 characters.
 The Tutorial - The entire beginning of the game has changed to focus more on pets and the idea that building on your planet will attract more.
 Rain - There is a chance that you will get rain periodically. Rain will automatically water all of your crops.
 Virtual Keyboard - A custom virtual keyboard to help with all the issues we have been having with the Steam Deck. Official verified steam dec
k support to come soon.

Changes

 One True Grid - all of the items in the game now work on the same grid (buildings, crops, furniture, etc.) This will allow you to put machines in your home. Also this includes better position snapping for fences.
 Pet Visit Conditions - There are many more pet visit conditions than just planting crops. I'll leave these for you to figure out!
 Pets have animations for chopping down trees, smashing meteors, and sitting.
 Crops - The grow time for crops has been fixed so they no longer grow instantly. Crops will also now grow even while you're away from your planet. You will still need to water each growth stage.
 The minimap now shows you a live view so it's always up to date.


Bug Fixes

 Fashion Show - The camera will no longer turn black and you should be able to play the game normally.
 Planet color changes correctly when going to another player's planet
 Travel Fallback - when you connect to a planet code that doesn't exist the game now puts you back where you came from with a network error message.
 Camera app crash should now be fixed

notes.title: Patch 4/25 - Dresses Update!
notes.notes:
New dresses and one pieces are now available at Marion's
 The Wardrobe - A new item you can craft that stores up to 100 pages of clothing items! It can be differentiated from the decorative wardrobes by the floating star above it.
 New Map app! Click it to zoom in and see more of the map.
 Fix for fashion minigame bug where the clothing screen would randomly close - this actually took me an entire 2 days to figure out
 Better planet rating function to calculate furniture
 Planet color adjustments
 Fix for some players being able to trigger the encounter twice by pressing interact really fast

notes.title: Mini patch! 4/22
notes.notes:
Inventory tooltip for controller
 Star house now actually spawns the star house instead of the cozy house
 Fixed shift clicking making items disappear
 Dropping an item onto a stack that isn't full now fills the stack up to the max and leaves the remainder in your selection
 Fixed furniture moving in and out of your inventory correctly
 Fix for furniture recipes saying "Needs Materials" even when you have the materials to craft it
 Fix for planet rating quest, having a planet rating > than B should also work for it now

notes.title: Happy Easter! Patch Notes 4/20
notes.notes:
Sorry for the late update this week but definitely some exciting stuff!

- Planet Environments! - A new way to customize your planet. Find all the different colors after completing the new quest!
- Furniture Saving Update - We changed the way furniture saves so that you're less likely to lose furniture when the game crashes. Please report any issues you find to us!
- Placing wall furniture has been fixed!
- A new house has been added to urban development.
- Hold the button to pickup storage containers.
- Shift click to move full stacks from your inventory to the storage container. Still working to figure out how to do something similar for the controller.
- Drops now will check surroundings before choosing a spot to drop. Should prevent drops going into walls or into areas you can't reach.
- A small fix for daily quests not completing correctly
- A fix for the watering can daily quest
- Fashion minigame theme not showing up fixed. Also added a transition screen clearly showing the theme to make it obvious for new players!
- The fishing tournament scoring has been fixed to include fish rarity. I'll be working on opening/closeing it automatically weekly and adding prizes soon!
- Phosies seeds now grow the correct tree! You should see them on alien planets as well now.
- Hold to sprint is now a setting you can toggle on.
- Fix for encounters where they were breaking when you chose something invalid.

notes.title: Patch Notes 4/11 - CONTROLLER SUPPORT!!!
notes.notes:
I spent the entire week working on controller support! I'm really excited for you all to try it and let me know what you think. There definitely will be some glitches here and there but I believe the game is 99% playable with the controller. I'll list what I covered below as well as some known glitches you might see.


 A pointer that looks just like the current mouse has been added so you can see what you're selecing
 Apps: Clothing, Tracker, Quests, etc. - Shoulder button switching added for navigation between tabs. Scrolling up and down will follow your pointer. 
 Fabricator, Blueprints, PetPak Mixer - Got the same treatment as above.
 Removed the out of place red X button from screens that had it. Added a quit button that shows the controller button you can use to exit back to the previous screen. It's also clickable.
 Game intro and Pet Encounter updated to work with controller.
 Button icons - Support has been added for Xbox (covers Steam Deck and other generic PC controllers), PlayStation, and Nintendo button icons.
 Minigames - Show the "How To Play" screen for each game with the Up D-Pad. Press Start to open settings and go back to HQ. Minigame results screens also updated to work with the pointer.
 Pet Deck - Selecting a card that's not your following pet will now swap it to the following position while using the controller.
 Pet Storage - Selecting a card in your storage will move the pet into your party and vice versa.


Known Controller Glitches

 Sometimes when in a screen/window your pointer will highlight the hot bar. We're working on this fix but it shouldn't affect your ability to play the game.
 Clothing App Camera - Didn't have time work on this one completely. It partially works but definitely needs attention.
 Certain times when opening the clothing app the pointer won't show up until you change tabs.


Other updates besides controller support!

 Dailies! - A bug with saving caused dailies to not appear for most people has been fixed. Everyone should get dailies now.
 Big fishing clean up! I cleaned up a ton of the code in fishing to hopefully clear up the buge we've been having. Please let me know if you continue to experience them! Or if there's new ones...
 Fix for the mystery man fishing quest so the fish he asks for don't change up.
 Removed the extra Trevally from the list of total fish.
 Mouths fixed - Finally figured out the bug that was causing the different mouths to not show up. Enjoy!
 Eri Tail fix
 Sprint is now a toggle. Press the sprint button to go into sprinting mode and press it again to go back to walking.


Unfortunately I didn't get to any other fixes or content updates because of all the controller support work I did this week. Hopefully next week I'll be able to dive back in and start fixing bugs and adding new content!

notes.title: Patch Notes 4/4
notes.notes:
3 new paks (It's a surprise!)
 More memory optimizations - tweaked a few graphics settings and found a bug that was causing memory spikes in HQ. Please let me know if you think it's smoother!
 Furniture app disabled anywhere but your planet
 Closing chat no longer locks movement
 Moved the Planet Rating quest to be after the storage quest
 Fish quest fish have been replaced with more common fish
 Pet movement has been changed to try and avoid running into walls
 Dice has been fixed so it doesn't consume
 Fixed a bug with Chop/Crush Paks that weren't granting more materials and rarer items with higher levels
 Fixed inventory not showing up the first time during an encounter
 Starfish can be picked up in HQ
 The HQ river now has a floor you can walk around in. Please let me know if you find any odd colliders

notes.title: Patch Notes 4/3
notes.notes:
Furniture grid fixes - Furniture should stack correctly now. Please let me know if there are any issues with specific pieces
 Furniture placing fixes - When placing furniture if hovering over existing placed furniture it no longer picks up. Should remove the visual dupe bug.
 Crafting UI fixes - Items are removed from Inventory and Hotbar at the same time to avoid weird issues with multiple stacks. Crafting UI will now tell you when your inventory is full and stop you. It also refreshes your inventory UI correctly now.
 PetPak Override - PetPaks of a higher level can be fed to a pet even if they are full to replace it's star level
 Beach Ball fix - Beach ball no longer dissapears when you use it. Using it again will teleport it in front of you.
 Alient Planets will now spawn phosies
 New Tutorial Format - The beginning of the game has been re-ordered a bit and more steps have been added to the initial quests to make it easier for new players. Chop and Crush Paks are now given to the player with mixing and level 2 paks moved to be later on. If you have time to start a new save I would love to know what you think about these changes!
 Memory Optimization - The game now runs on about ~2.5GB of memory! (previously 5-6 GB)  I did this by optimizing some graphics so if you see anything weird or missing please let me know.

notes.title: Patch Notes 3/31
notes.notes:
Texture optimziations - A bit of optimization to hopefully make the game run a bit smoother
 Fish rarities tweaked - More expensive fish are a bit rarer now
 Pet Pak Discovery - Quest fixed so it works by just discovering the paks
 Fishing Camera - Fishing was being interrupted by chat so it's been changed so chat can only open if everything else is closed
 Chat fix for minigames
 Purifier quest update - Fixed Grendela explaining what the purifier is and how it works
 Cap PetPaks to level 3 - You technically could've made bigger ones but they would've worked as level 1 anyway. I would toss any that you have with a bigger level because they may glitch your game.
 New eye colors! - Black, Gray, Pink, Orange, Light Green, Light Blue, Dark Yellow and a few adjustments to current colors
 Furniture Saving fix - Furniture in rooms was resetting when going online. That's now been fixed!
 Quest App Requirements - Quest requirements are now shown inside the quest app so you don't have to pin it.
 Creature Move temporary fix - Not going to be the final fix but temprorily making it so creatures move regardless of obstacles. You may see them run into things and get stuck but figured this was better than overlapping ones.
 Frisbee throw angle fix - Lowered the throw angle so it's easier to catch

notes.title: Patch 3/29 - 11:52 AM ET
notes.notes:
Another fix for crafting ui
 Fishing in HQ fix. There was a bug that was having fishing rods affect each other. Also when other players catch fish their fish should properly put away now.
 Fish rarities and sell price changes - all fish have been properly priced. The rarer the fish the more expensive they sell for! Also their star level affects their sell price.
 Hotbar tutorial - seeing a few players confused about the hot bar. So new tutorial in the beginning to explain what it is and how to use it

notes.title: Patch Notes 3/28 - 5:00 PM ET
notes.notes:
Fabricator UI fixed
 Furniture App Rework - Default you enter edit mode for furniture. Right click to open the furniture menu and choose to place an item. Click an item to move it. Hover over an item and press G to remove it. The tutorial in game now matches this but some of you may have already passed it.
 Account Settings - If you would like to change your password to your username you can now do so in settings. This will enable you to log into your account on other devices.
 Login button - if you get logged out for some reason you can now log in using the login button.
 Chat colors - your chat username is now a random color based on your username to help better differentiate each message
